topic: Holstein Housewares Cup Drip Coffee vs Elite Gourmet EHC Personal Single
angle: Head-to-head: which of these two is the smarter buy for most people?

reviews.title: Elite Gourmet EHC Personal Single
pros: Zero ongoing pod costs — permanent reusable filter means you buy beans once, brew forever
Double-wall stainless thermal mug actually keeps coffee hot for 2+ hours, unlike glass carafes
Compact footprint (about 8 inches wide) fits tight counter spaces, dorm rooms, or office desks
